fato_historico: 1954: Aeroflot Flight 136 crashes near Krasnoyarsk, killing 19.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you navigate life with extra grace today. As you embark on your personal journey, remember that even in moments of sudden stillness or reflection, your spirit remains resilient. It is a good time to cherish the path you walk and consider how every step adds to your vibrant story of growth and expansion.
frase_do_dia: Keep your face to the sunshine and shadows will fall behind you.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of cycles and the arrival of new wisdom.
conselho: Trust your intuition and find joy in the small miracles of today.
